title: 第11章 无债一身轻第12章 黄金屋
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：财富自由从毕业开始第11章无债一身轻（..）《真·仪态训练书》。
周望看过系统的介绍后，就这么一个想法。
不像“青龙刀”
那么直接，给的是物质奖励，这本“菲奥娜的仪态训练书”
改善的是周望自身的状态。
虽然没有感觉很惊喜，但周望想了想，“崔斯特的青龙刀”
是88分的时候给的，而“仪态训练书”
则是97分的时候给的。
从这个角度来分析的话，说明在系统的判定中，“仪态训练书”
明显比“青龙刀”
更珍贵，毕竟印象分达到97肯定要更难。
30天的周期还是挺长的，周望也没有过多纠结，直接点击了“使用”
仓库中的“仪态训练书”
刹那间消失不见，与此同时，周望感觉自己的脑海中多了些什么东西，他说不明白，感觉更像是一种潜意识的执念。
下一秒，原本瘫在后座上的周望“唰”
的一下就坐了起来，搞得司机都吓了一跳。
“什么鬼！”
但周望自己也很是懵逼，刚才那一刻，周望只觉得这种葛优瘫的姿势哪哪都不舒服，也没多想就遵循本能坐了起来。
此刻周望回味了一下，才隐约察觉到了“仪态训练书”
的作用。

他体内好像多了一根看不见的发条，在他又想瘫软下去的时候，就会出现浑身别扭、四肢不协调等症状。
周望哭笑不得，老实说，这种感觉并不是太舒服，所以当个优雅的贵族也要付出代价的吗？
现在的周望，就感觉他丧失了一种名为“躺平”
的快乐……
路上周望又尝试了多种姿势，最终当他抵达学校门口的时候，礼貌请他下车的司机看了一眼脊背挺直、微微抬头、单手支着车窗眼神深邃的周望，眼神怪异。
你小子真踏马能装，坐個专车硬是让你整出总裁范了是吧！
拎着一堆东西的周望，先在学校门口买了一条中支的大重九，然后就迅速赶往了食堂。
加叉烧加鸡腿的大份猪脚饭get，加冰块加柠檬的快乐肥宅水get，等回到宿舍把门一关，已经饿疯了的周望迅速打开了电脑。
结果……20分钟过去了，他愣是还没有吃上一口饭。
原因很简单，找不到合适的剧。
“我要你这VIP有何用！”
周望恨铁不成钢的骂了一句，虽然登录的会员账号都不是他的，但并不妨碍他替某位舍友感到不值。
妥协的周望打开了短视频app，随便找了一部“这个男人叫小帅”
的影视解说，这才顺利的吃上了饭。
只是在吃饭的时候，刚才走路就感觉到的那种别扭又来了，而且尤为明显。
礼仪书正在强制矫正他吃饭的姿态，其实主要是进食的频率问题。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Financial Freedom Begins from Graduation, Chapter 11 Debt-Free and Lightweight (..) "True Deportment Training Book".
Zhou Wang had this idea after reading the introduction of the system.
Unlike the "Blue Dragon Sword"
So direct, giving a material reward, this "Fiona's Deportment Training Book"
What improves is Zhou Wang’s own condition.
Although he didn't feel very surprised, Zhou Wang thought for a while, "Twisted Fate's Azure Dragon Sword"
It was given when I scored 88 points, and the "Deportment Training Book"
It was given when it scored 97 points.
Analyzed from this perspective, it shows that in the judgment of the system, the "Deportment Training Book"
Obviously better than "Qinglong Sword"
It’s more precious, after all, it’s definitely harder to get an impression score of 97.
The 30-day cycle is quite long, so Zhou Wang didn’t hesitate too much and clicked “Use” directly.
"Deportment Training Book" in the warehouse
It disappeared in an instant. At the same time, Zhou Wang felt that there was something more in his mind. He couldn't explain it. It felt more like a subconscious obsession.
The next second, Zhou Wang, who was slumped in the back seat, said "Whoosh"
He sat up in an instant, making the driver startled.
"What the hell!"
But Zhou Wang himself was also very confused. At that moment, Zhou Wang felt that Ge You's paralyzed posture was uncomfortable everywhere, so he followed his instinct and sat up without thinking much.
At this moment, Zhou Wang thought about it for a while, and then he vaguely noticed the "Deportment Training Book"
role.
It was as if there was an invisible spring in his body. When he wanted to go limp again, symptoms such as awkwardness all over his body and uncoordinated limbs would appear.
Zhou Wang couldn't laugh or cry. To be honest, this feeling is not very comfortable, so does being an elegant noble have to pay a price?
Looking around now, it feels like he has lost a feeling called "lying flat"
of happiness...
Wang Wang tried various postures on the road. Finally, when he arrived at the school gate, the driver who politely asked him to get out of the car looked at Zhou Wang with his back straight, his head slightly raised, and his one hand supporting the car window with a deep look in his eyes.
You kid is really good at pretending. Taking a special car will force you to act like a CEO, right?
Zhou Wang, who was carrying a bunch of things, first bought a pair of Zhongzhong Da Chongjiu at the school gate, and then hurried to the cafeteria.
A large portion of pig's trotter rice with barbecued pork and chicken legs was served, and a Happy Fat House water with ice cubes and lemon was served. After returning to the dormitory and closing the door, Zhou Wang, who was already crazy with hunger, quickly turned on the computer.
As a result... 20 minutes passed, and he still hadn't taken a bite of food.
The reason is simple: I can't find a suitable drama.
"What do I need from your VIP!"
Zhou Wang cursed bitterly. Although the member account he logged in was not his, it did not prevent him from feeling unworthy for a certain roommate.
Compromising, Zhou Wang opened the short video app and randomly found a movie called "This man's name is Xiaoshuai"
film and television commentary, and then I had my meal smoothly.
But when I was eating, the awkwardness I felt just now when I walked came back again, and it was especially obvious.
The etiquette book is forcing him to correct his eating posture. In fact, the main issue is the frequency of eating.
